name: Mansion of Sadness
source:
Dimitris stood in front of the mansion for almost a whole minute without moving.

He was in awe.

He is starting his new job in this mansion today.

[From [url=https://kakoeimon.itch.io/manor-of-sadness]Itchio[/url]]
